title: BookForge Workflow Schema
description: Defines the structure of a BookForge workflow. Workflows are multi-step compositions that orchestrate agents, skills, and validators.

version.description: Workflow schema version (separate from runtime contract)

phase.description: Workflow phase in the book production lifecycle

entry.description: Path to the workflow definition file relative to project root

requires.description: Artifact paths that must exist before this workflow can run

human_approval.description: Whether this workflow requires human approval before commit

scale.description: Expected scale of work this workflow handles

id.description: Unique step identifier within this workflow

action.description: Action to perform (context.build, agent.run, validator.run, etc.)

agent.description: Agent ID to use for this step (optional)

requires.description: Step IDs that must complete before this step

produces.description: Artifact IDs produced by this step

outputs.description: Artifact IDs produced by this workflow

validators.description: Validators to run after workflow completion
